items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: Yeah, we had a pretty fair reading band. Yeah, he was on drums. I was on cornet. A fellow by the name of Elmer Talbot.

ctx.x: Yeah, we had a pretty fair reading band. Yeah, he was on drums. I was on cornet. A fellow by the name of Elmer Talbot. We used to call him Cuckoo. Oh, yeah.
I heard him. He was playing George Lewis.
